issues.display_title: Issue #487: Published Folder Bookmark Profile Category
issues.main_description_html:
RESULT 04/08/26

✅ Implementation: Published Folder Bookmark Profile Category

Summary

The published-folder profile API now returns category_id for each folder. Frontend can use this value to select the folder category logo.

Route

GET /bookmark/published/profile/:username?page=1&limit=9

Registered in src/Routes/V1/BookmarksRoutes.go:

Bookmark.Get("/published/profile/:username", Controllers.ListPublishedFolderBookmarkProfile)

The route already existed and was not changed.

Changes

Query

Added v.category_id to the existing projection:

Select("v.slug, v.name, v.category_id, v.thumbnail, COALESCE(v.published_at, fb.published_at, fb.updated_at, fb.created_at) AS published_at, v.total_bookmark")

Model

Added a nullable category ID to PublishedFolderBookmarkProfile:

CategoryID *int64 `json:"category_id"`

Preserved Behavior

  • Existing single thumbnail is unchanged.
  • No category name or logo is returned.
  • name, slug, published_at, and total_bookmark are unchanged.
  • Pagination, roles, block/deactive checks, encrypted response, and errors are unchanged.
  • views_published_folders already exposes category_id; no DDL update was needed.

Files Changed

  • src/Action/V1/Bookmarks/ListPublishedFolderBookmarkProfile.go
  • src/Models/FolderBookmarkModel.go
  • docs/API/Profile_Published_Folder_Bookmarks.md
  • Existing task and implementation documentation dated 16-07-2026

Response Addition

{
  "category_id": 3
}

Verification

Ran:

go test ./src/Action/V1/Bookmarks ./src/Models

Result: pass; packages currently contain no test files.
